oneLiner: A dashboard that instantly re-orients PMs switching between projects by surfacing the last decision made, open blockers, and who's waiting on what.
problem: PMs juggle multiple projects at once and lose critical context every time they switch, wasting the first 10-15 minutes on each project reconstructing 'where did we leave off' instead of taking action.
targetUser: Product managers overseeing 3+ concurrent projects who context-switch between them multiple times a day and rely on scattered tools (Slack, docs, tickets) to reconstruct status.
coreFlow: PM logs in and sees a list of active projects with last-touched time and health signal
PM selects a project to re-enter
Dashboard surfaces the last decision made, including rationale and date
Dashboard shows current blockers with owners and status
Dashboard shows who's waiting on the PM and what they need
PM takes action (respond, unblock, delegate) or marks context reviewed and switches to the next project

screens.name: Project Switcher
screens.purpose: Give a bird's-eye view of all active projects with status and last activity so the PM can choose where to jump in

screens.name: Re-entry Brief
screens.purpose: Single consolidated view showing the last decision, open blockers, and who's waiting, so the PM regains context in seconds

screens.name: Decision Log
screens.purpose: Chronological history of key decisions per project for deeper context or audit

screens.name: Blocker Detail
screens.purpose: Drill into a specific blocker to see owner, timeline, and update its status

screens.name: Waiting-On Queue
screens.purpose: Cross-project list of everyone currently waiting on the PM, prioritized by urgency

outOfScope: Full task/project management (not a replacement for Jira, Linear, or Asana)
AI-generated decisions or automated prioritization in v1
